messages.subject: Re: Live music at The Thatched House
messages.body:
Hi,

Just gently chasing my earlier note on Jake Essex.

He's from Essex, own PA, no deposit, from £300 for two one hour sets,
or £250 a night when you book four. Saturday nights in 2027. He's free
Sat 12 June, Sat 2 October and Sat 27 November 2027, from 8pm. If a
date works, just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Natalie

messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Bretons Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi Nigel,

Thanks for coming back to me. Jake is fully booked for the rest of this year, and his Saturdays up to March are mostly taken already, but he does have two Saturday evenings free:

Saturday 20 February 2027, from 8pm
Saturday 20 March 2027, from 8pm

It's two one-hour sets, own PA, no deposit, £250 cash on the night. If either suits, just let me know and I'll pencil it in for you. Happy to look at April onwards too if those don't work.

Kind regards,
Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
